definition: A decoding strategy that samples multiple chain-of-thought reasoning paths for the same question and selects the most consistent final answer among them.
details: Self-consistency improves reasoning accuracy by treating agreement across diverse reasoning paths as a signal of correctness, rather than relying on a single greedy generation.
story: Picture a novelist who has read so much that, given a first line, they cannot help but write the next one. Boil it down and it is this: A decoding strategy that samples multiple chain-of-thought reasoning paths for the same question and selects the most consistent final answer among them. Here is why it matters: Self-consistency improves reasoning accuracy by treating agreement across diverse reasoning paths as a signal of correctness, rather than relying on a single greedy generation. It is prediction pushed forward — each next word, or pixel, guessed from everything that came before it. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Self-Consistency.

citation.title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
